purpose: Teach: テナント/争議/励まさ/数回/封じ/裏付ける/先代/小論文

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、テナント、絶対、ビルの、絶対、防犯、絶対、警察、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're taking this matter seriously. We've strengthened patrols and security measures at the building. I appreciate your cooperation.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Steady cadence. Each sentence lands with quiet conviction. Slightly formal register — the official voice, not the personal one.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労働、本気で、絶対、争議、絶対、関連の、絶対、ご相談、絶対、警察様、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for your support on this. We've been consulting with you on everything related to the labor dispute.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Nods in his tone. Slightly formal — the deference of someone speaking to authority, but genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、被害者を、絶対、励まされ、絶対、る、絶対、よう、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's right. We're making sure the victims are treated with care throughout this process.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. The tone of someone delivering protocol but meaning it. Even pacing. No flourish — just clarity and compassion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の、本気で、絶対、ご訪問、絶対、数回、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've really appreciated the several times you've visited us to check in.
lines.style: Warm and sincere. A beat of genuine gratitude beneath the formality. Slightly softer than before — acknowledging the personal care behind the official visits.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 犯罪を、本気で、絶対、封じる、絶対、よう、絶対、警察、絶対、巡回、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're also increasing patrols to make sure we can prevent any further incidents.
lines.style: Firm and confident. Steady attack on the opening. The tone of someone stating what will be done, not asking permission. Professional resolve.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、証言を、絶対、裏付ける、絶対、資料、絶対、警察様に、絶対、提出しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've submitted all our documentation and witness statements to support the investigation.
lines.style: Straightforward and matter-of-fact. No hesitation. The tone of someone checking off a box but doing it with real care for accuracy.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、先代、絶対、署長の方針、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. We're continuing the approach my predecessor established — maintaining those standards and staying committed to the community.
lines.style: Measured and reflective. A slight pause at the mention of the predecessor — honoring continuity. Steady. The voice of institutional memory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、防犯、絶対、小論文、絶対、コンクール、絶対、警察様と、絶対、開催しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In fact, we're working with your department on a crime-prevention essay contest for our staff. It's been a great way to build awareness.
lines.style: Slightly more animated than before — a hint of pride in this collaboration. Still professional, but warmer. The door closing, relationship intact.
